What are general red flags for a board getting too heavy?
- Sluggish loading / lag when opening the board (before it fully breaks).
- Browser tab freezing or high CPU/memory usage when on the board.
- Widgets taking longer to refresh/update than before.
- Lag when dragging cards or scrolling.
- Summary widgets showing stale data or partial loads.
- Very large numbers of items/cards on the board or aggregated by widgets.
- Many complex cross-board connections or automations.
